notes.title: "ANONYMOUS ME" 2017.11.27 patch update announcement
notes.content:
Dear players:
Thank you for your support of our game and feedback to us a lot of game problems, the following is an update:
1. Fixed the protagonist attributes interface and some parts of the blood-less interface UI display
2. Fixed Jinyang Town BOSS has a low probability of falling below the surface line of the problem
3. Fixed the press RB in North Handle to activate the problem of failed blood-print operation
4. Fixed the issue of being attacked by monsters after the death of the protagonist in certain situations
5. Adjust the activation of blood, the crystallization of the items when the message is not enough, in order to avoid confusion [lack of concept of crystallization] to [lack of crystallization]

About the handle issues:
Currently available to support the XboxOne Xbox360 Windows emulation mode PS4 handle, as well as some of the North Handle.
Since the version publish , we are attention has been paid to some feedbacks concerning the abnormality of the handle. Now the problem of the handle is solved uniformly, and some solutions to the problem are attached.

It is currently known that some of the handles (especially the PS4 handles) are prone to confusion in the input buttons when configuration support for various handles in "Controller Settings" is enabled in the "Steam Big Screen" mode.
We have confirmed that some of the Northbridge handles are supported for some problems with the Northbridge handles, but given the large number of Northbridge devices, full support may not be achieved in the short term. For Beidong Handheld devices that have encountered support problems or unusual button recognition, it is recommended that you use keyboard mapping software to map or simulate it as an Xbox handle. We apologize for the problems with the handle support on the company and the development team is paying close attention to it and will soon complete its support of the North Handle.
Finally, thank you for the "ANONYMOUS ME" support, follow-up we will bring more and better game content

notes.title: From the Shadow Emerges “Anonymous Me”, Oct 13 on Steam
notes.content: Alone amidst a vast snowy landscape, she is alone. There is no one to rely on but her wits and long sword, which shimmers out of its ornate sheath. On October 13th, Dragonest publishing is proud to release Anonymous Me, developed by RKTime: an epic 2D action slasher set in ancient China, onto Steam ！

Dear Players,

After serious consideration, we decided to postpone one day of the Early Access version of Anonymous Me, we apologize of making this decision, but we decided as we want to provide a better condition. 

So far, we still have some issues to be dealed with and we don’t want to release the game with such problems to bring bad game experience to you all. 

So it’s had to be postpone by one day of the publish time which is at Oct. 13th. Thank you very much for your understanding. 

see you tomorrow.

notes.title: Anonymous Me slated for official release on Oct 12!
notes.content:
Anonymous Me , a 2D action platformer, The Early Access version will be official released on Steam on Oct 12. 

The game is set in Qin Dynasty of China. Players will experience the turmoil of this era and feel the joys and sorrows of the ordinary people. The protagonist, Mang, was an 
assassin. She called it quits after the organization she was in fell apart. However, Mang is somehow plunged into a huge conspiracy due to a seemingly simple kidnapping.

Anonymous Me boasts graphics of Chinese ink wash painting style and stunningly beautiful scenes with various weather effects. Its melancholy music adds to the unique atmosphere. Mang can cycle through three weapons to unravel the mysteries of this shattered empire.

Anonymous Me is our first game on Steam. It went through many changes during development and has been delay for many times. Now it finally sees the light of day. 
Thank you for your support and understanding! We hope you enjoy it!

For more info, please contact us via
